invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null 'result' argument to perform its logic safely.
The 'commit' implementation immediately invokes 'getWriteStatuses' on 'result', so it should not be null.
The code maps over the WriteStatuses, so all WriteStatus entries should be non-null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
The implementation immediately calls 'getStat' on each WriteStatus, so each must be non-null and have non-null stats.
A List's size is always non-negative; ensures getWriteStatuses returns a valid List.
